name: Manojavam Maruta Tulya Vegam
text:
मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् ।
वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये ॥
meaning: I seek refuge in Hanuman, swift as the mind and the wind, master of the senses, foremost of the wise, son of the wind and messenger of Rama.
purpose: A praise verse invoking alertness, disciplined strength and service.
supports: Focus; self-control; courage; acting with purpose rather than impulse.
when: Before demanding work, or when preparing to face a challenge.
